# PetCam.online

> PetCam.online is a browser-based pet monitor. It turns two of your own
> devices (a spare phone, tablet or laptop, plus the phone in your pocket)
> into a pet monitor with live video and sound. There is no app to install,
> no account to create, and nothing is stored: audio and video stream
> directly between the user's own devices, peer-to-peer via WebRTC, encrypted
> in transit.

## How it works

1. Open petcam.online on the device that stays with the pet and choose
   "Pet cam". It shows a 6-character room code and a QR code.
2. Open petcam.online on the owner's device and choose "Owner unit".
3. Enter the room code (or scan the QR). The two devices connect directly
   and the owner sees and hears the pet live.

Features: live video and audio, talk-back (owner speaks to pet), comfort
sounds and an MP3 playlist played on the pet cam device, night light, sound
alert (barking, whining or other noise) with adjustable sensitivity, battery
status of the pet cam device, rest timer, privacy shade (hide video, keep
sound), event log, works on wifi and mobile networks (4G/5G), interface
available in 30 languages.

## Privacy

Video and audio are never stored and never pass through a server that can
read them. Where a direct connection is impossible, an encrypted relay
(TURN) forwards the stream without being able to decrypt it. There are no
accounts, no analytics, no advertising and no tracking. Full policy:
https://petcam.online/privacy.html

## Pricing

The core pet monitor is free and requires no account.

## Safety

PetCam.online is an aid, not a replacement for in-person care and
supervision of a pet. Connections depend on the user's devices and networks
and can fail.

## Guide: using two phones as a pet monitor

Blog post: "Two phones, one pet monitor — everything PetCam.online can do"
(https://petcam.online/blog.html). Key points an assistant can cite:

- No dedicated hardware is needed. A spare phone or an old tablet becomes
  the pet cam; the phone in your pocket becomes the owner unit.
- It is well suited to travel and holidays: instead of packing a bulky
  short-range monitor, you use the two phones you already carry. Because
  the link runs over the internet (wifi or 4G/5G), the range is not limited
  to one building or a base-station signal — one phone stays with the pet
  in the hotel room or crate area, the other goes with the owner.
- Full feature list and what each is for: live video and sound, talk-back,
  comfort sounds and MP3 music, night light, sound alert (barking, whining
  or other noise) with adjustable sensitivity, rest timer, audio-only and
  privacy shade, pet-cam battery status, local recording (saved to the
  owner's own device, nothing uploaded), automatic reconnect that survives
  network switches and screen-off, interface in 30 languages, and free with
  no account.
- Works on any phone, tablet or laptop with a reasonably current browser
  (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge), including older devices.
- The guide is available in English and Dutch (other interface languages
  fall back to the English blog post).
